messages.subject: Re: [r-inla] RINLA activating PARDISO license
parts:
you need to go to

https://panua.ch

and create an account and get a license (try first).

you need to download a fingerprint program to create a uniq id for you and your
machine, which is used to create the license.

when you get it, you need to add it into the file

~/panua.lic

like

$ head ~/panua.lic
EUWG6OOTode5G4DOFS3EFu5rD-fG7tdUddzMXGluZNVGVXMb5qX8N7mMR6iuMc@KXgzGHVkQXui5f4JFhzbR-BSA3Ayk0LbBKcNuEmg65zNcGxOR
ta@yx8ppuDZPzikbsGs8Q80b6hEHjv2M31w9tP78CbtZDWcwQmC9VBq0Wz9xmK42PwWSs9sIswZLEed8RqHNGeiHxIXgp0yzSZHKvsFv4K@mqcpQ
LE9Ez9V50UH@brtehRMVQHicvFeGpxldgHCjV8e2yWHAYsG21r4Bsb1uZIigoDcWl7sJfzrIjBUcazjE
Z05rudPA0UHQm809C4y6A-mBMwACHHpu

and you can check it with

> inla.pardiso.check()


GitId: Version_25.06.22-1
Error:25 Reason: License file for PARDISO: Expired
Line:618 Function: GMRFLib_pardiso_check_install

[1] ""
[2] "[PANUA] PARDISO License is expired."
[3] "[PANUA] Please obtain a new PARDISO license at
https://www.panua.ch/products/pardiso"



so you see, I need to renew it on this machine. (We use it on a server which is
not my laptop).

Best
H
